name: Long Recall Variant 4
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 55-page environmental impact study: 5 factory sites (page 3), total emissions 45,000 tons CO2 (page 8), water usage 2.3M gallons (page 12), recycling rate 35% (page 18), energy from renewables 22% (page 25), compliance cost $1.8M (page 32), 3 violations (page 38), improvement plan $4.5M (page 45).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
